d: Wavy, shoulder-length chestnut brown hair is styled with a side part and voluminous curls. The golden-brown eyes are narrow and sleepy, set on a face with the soft features of a young adolescent. A slender build is dressed in a burnt-orange dress with a white ruffled collar, layered under a long, dark charcoal oversized trench coat and paired with sheer dark brown tights and black loafers. Signature details include a thin black wire mask covering the lower face, a gold necklace with small white beads, and a glass jar held in gloved hands.
